title: Speaking — Reading habits
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on reading habits.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
What do you usually read for pleasure?
Do you read more on paper or on a screen?

part2.topic: Describe something you read that changed how you thought about a subject.
part2.closing: and explain how your opinion changed.

questions: How can schools encourage reading outside lessons?
How has easy access to short articles affected people's reading habits?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to reading habits?
